summary.text: Karel Crawford is a Republican state representative from Carroll 3 who has served in the House since 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Crawford is a business owner and former Moultonborough school board member and selectman.

paragraphs.text: Karel Crawford's career experience includes owning a business, and she has served on the Moultonborough School Board and the Moultonborough Selectboard.
Crawford has served on the House Transportation Committee in each session Ballotpedia lists from 2013 through 2024, including as clerk in 2021-2022.
